preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings across test cases does not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[2*i].strip().upper() == 'YES' and len(output_lines[2*i+1].strip()) == len(test_cases[i]) + 1 and output_lines[2*i+1].strip() != output_lines[2*i+1].strip()[::-1]) or (output_lines[2*i].strip().upper() == 'NO' and output_lines[2*i+1].strip() == '') for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, if the answer is YES, the next line contains a string of length |s|+1 that is not a palindrome; if NO, the next line is empty (or the pair represents the NO case correctly).

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[2*i].strip().upper() == 'YES' and 'a' in output_lines[2*i+1].strip() and output_lines[2*i+1].strip().replace('a', '', 1) == test_cases[i]) or (output_lines[2*i].strip().upper() == 'NO' and all((test_cases[i][:j] + 'a' + test_cases[i][j:]) == (test_cases[i][:j] + 'a' + test_cases[i][j:])[::-1] for j in range(len(test_cases[i]) + 1))) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If YES, the constructed string is formed by inserting exactly one 'a' into the input string s at some position, and it is not a palindrome. If NO, it is impossible to insert 'a' anywhere in s to form a non-palindrome (i.e., all possible insertions result in palindromes).
